data.description:
## Description

**What**: New shared script plugins/dso/scripts/apply-host-overlay.sh (the overlay engine): walks plugins/dso/templates/host-project/, applies {{PROJECT_NAME}} substitution per existing installer convention, copies into target, leaves a one-line audit comment in dso-config.conf. Reusable beyond create-dso-app.sh. Ship the in-plugin overlay tree with canonical files (CLAUDE.md template, dso-config.conf, .pre-commit-config.yaml, project-understanding.md skeleton, design-notes.md skeleton, ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md skeleton with {{PROJECT_NAME}} placeholders).
**Why**: Phased installer needs an extracted, independently-testable overlay engine; future retrofit-DSO-onto-existing-Strata-project tools will reuse it.
**Scope**:
- IN: apply-host-overlay.sh with text-extension whitelist + `file -b --mime` binary detection; collision-protection (--overlay-mode=skip|overwrite|merge default skip = refuse to overwrite); idempotent (re-run produces zero diff); audit comment written exactly once per dso-config.conf; in-plugin overlay tree under plugins/dso/templates/host-project/; full Strata Posture written from strata-config-defaults.conf at install time.
- OUT: Sourcing strata-config-defaults.conf from outside this engine (separate story); Rails SDK gem-add (separate story); fork archival (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, apply-host-overlay.sh invoked directly produces correct output against a target directory ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, collision-protection refuses to overwrite by default; --overlay-mode=overwrite/merge work as documented ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, binary fixtures (image, lock-file) are NOT substituted ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, idempotent re-run produces zero diff ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, the FULL Strata Posture section is written from strata-config-defaults.conf using install-time _commit + _src_path so A2's idempotency check produces zero diffs ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for substitution, collision modes, binary detection, idempotency

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Audit comment must be detectable for idempotency; do not append duplicates
- [Maintainability] Overlay engine reused outside create-dso-app.sh — keep CLI surface minimal and stable

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a script author, apply-host-overlay.sh applies the in-plugin host-project tree with collision/binary safety
